title: Live GPS HUD, Z9–Z4 zoom & unguided ML
features: Unguided local ML learning: Preferred Nearby POIs, Usual Parking (including habitual car parks with no saved places nearby), POI-named stops/predictions and Usual Route shortcuts now learn without an active route.
Unguided commute alerts: Likely traffic ahead, Frequent slowdown ahead and Cold-weather slowdown ahead now warn without a route, with dynamic smooth-pass hazard decay and age expiry.
Weekday vs. weekend weighting for destination predictions, plus Adaptive Auto-zoom aligned to Z9–Z4 hysteresis bands with a 20-second sustained-override guard.

Live expandable GPS HUD inside the top clock pill (HH:MM:SS seconds, Day/Night compass dial, accuracy, satellites, altitude and coordinates), adapting cleanly to popups and menus — toggled by double-OK or console REPEAT.
Expanded Auto zoom and manual driving zoom across Z9–Z4 with speed hysteresis, plus crisp Z7–Z9 close-up road geometry and street names using existing map packs.
Tighter View diversion and View route Explore framing across the full 480 × 272 screen.
